verdict.rationale: Glama's /mcp/reference page describes programmatically searching the curated catalog, inspecting server capabilities, and keeping your own directory synchronized. A connector JSON schema and an llms.txt exist, and a community user mentions making 'API attempts' to trigger rebuilds, so some public API surface is implied. However, no OpenAPI or Swagger spec was found at any probed path. Community reports also say neither a user nor their agent could find documentation explaining why rebuild/retest calls failed (an undocumented credit-card requirement), so documentation coverage for driving the product end-to-end is weak. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI spec or detailed endpoint documentation, documented auth and API keys, API coverage of hosting, deploy and rebuild actions, and independent hands-on confirmation of successful API use.
